data.reasoningText:
The regex replacement broke some things. The issue is with the Deserialize regex - it matched too eagerly. `JsonSerializer.Deserialize<OperationStatusResult>(item.GetRawText())` should become `JsonSerializer.Deserialize(item.GetRawText(), ArmSerializerContext.Default.OperationStatusResult)` but instead got `JsonSerializer.Deserialize(item.GetRawText(, ArmSerializerContext.Default.OperationStatusResult))`.

The problem is the regex `r'JsonSerializer\.Deserialize<OperationStatusResult>\(([^)]+)\)'` where `([^)]+)` matched `item.GetRawText(` because it's greedy up to the first `)`. 

I need to handle the nested parentheses properly with a more careful approach.
